items.title: El Casi, material d’Arxiu

items.titleEn: The Case, material from the Archives
items.summaryEn: The bibliophile and collector cedes to the National Archives a hundred packs of glass from the first decade of the 20th century. You can check it out in the virtual gallery soon.
